primary_title: Tyrosine 813 Is a Site of JAK2 Autophosphorylation Critical for Activation of JAK2 by SH2-Bbeta
decision_basis: Primary JAK2 Y813F and SH2-Bbeta assays support pY813-dependent adaptor docking and SH2-Bbeta-mediated enhancement of JAK2 activity.
limitations_preserved: Preserve pY813, SH2-Bbeta SH2-domain, growth-hormone/COS-7 context and no terminal-TF or SCI inference.
